page.layout: One column of running text in the centre of the page. No marginal notes. Running head at the top right of the text block. Catchword at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: &[?] viginti annos natus, incautè obedire studet, debitas pœnas violati fœderis Amurathi persoluit. Nam dum Amurathes bellum, innumeris copiis se cum adductis, committit, magnaque suorum clade accepta, tandem & ipse, ab Eugenio deceptus, ferro[?] occubuit. Ferunt hunc Eugenium, mirum in modum amasse bella: & multa indignatione permotum, Ludovicum Delphinum, Caroli septimi Francorum regis filium, cum magno comitatu in Basilienses concitasse, unde mala infinita sequebantur. Et ubi Romam postea venit, urbi multa contulit. Maximè circa Vaticanum, aerarij officinam & aream palatii instauravit: ac vias publicas multis in locis strauit. Picturam basilicæ Lateranensis, à Martino inchoatam in pariete, absoluit: porticumque, qua ad Sancta sanctorum itur, extruxit. Monasterium quod iuxta Lateranum est, refecit: ac pulsis inde canonicis secularibus, Frisona-rios regulares ex Lucensis agri loco accitos, introduxit. Basilicam S. Petri reparavit: atque eius sacristiam multa supellectili donavit. Scholas quasdam instituit: ac gymnasia sophisticis doctoribus fouit. Monachos omnes mirum in modum dilexit: & mendicantes fraterculos privilegiis & gratiis auxit.

page.notes: Printed lines are normalised for u/v and i/j as instructed. Uncertain readings: the opening abbreviation before "viginti" (drawn like &, marked [?]); "ferro" at the line end of "fr / ro occubuit", where the first letters are blurred; catchword "man=" at the lower right, marked [?]. "Frisona-rios" is read from the hyphenated line end and may be a misreading of the name. The printed hyphen after "refor" and the "=" in the catchword are taken as printed.
